The Broom Tree is proud to offer grants of up to $1,000 per person to support local families with children who have disabilities. These grants are designed to assist with financial support for travel expenses, including gas and hotel stays for out-of-town doctor appointments, we also help with the purchase of essential items and services, such as adaptive strollers, medical equipment, seating devices, and more. To apply for a grant, please fill out our application form, providing details on the specific items or services you need and their associated costs. By offering this support, we aim to alleviate some of the financial burdens faced by families and improve the well-being and quality of life for children with disabilities.
